bagPolicy.summary: Hangout Music Festival is not being held in 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: Gulf Shores tourism (the city's official visitor site) says the producers elected not to hold a 2026 event and that Hangout is expected to return in May 2027; no 2027 dates or entry rules are posted yet. The festival's own site still shows the 2024 edition. Last published rule (2024): clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and empty hydration packs with one pocket besides the bladder.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Hangout Music Festival can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Hangout Music Festival's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Hangout Music Festival offers a variety of food and drink options, including dozens of restaurants and the Hangout Restaurant for a shaded, air-conditioned meal. The Nosh Pit provides snacks all day long in a new shaded dining pavilion.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Every festival entrance has an ADA entry lane for guests with disabilities and one companion. After entering, visit the Access Center inside the entrance on Gulf Shores Parkway to request ADA accommodations. Drivers with a valid placard can drop off guests at the ADA Loading & Unloading Zone in the ADA Parking Lot.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: 3-Day weekend wristband holders can re-enter all weekend, as long as the wristband is secured and untampered.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office and Will Call are at 200 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542. Orders that can't be delivered go to Will Call, and pickup requires the original purchaser or person who activated the wristband, a photo ID, and the credit card used.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates open at 12 p.m. each day, and music start times vary by day. Bikes aren't allowed inside, but bike racks are near the entrance.
